title: Chinna Thambi
desc: After an astrologer predicts that their sister will marry a man of her own choosing, three protective brothers go to dire lengths to prevent the prophecy from being fulfilled.

title: Tamizh Selvan
desc: Tamil Selvan, an honest IAS officer, falls in love with Fathima, a research scholar. Later due to a turn of events, he attracts the ire of Vedimuthu, a corrupt MLA, and his family.

title: Enga Chinna Rasa
desc: Chinnarasu, a naive boy loves his stepmother dearly and fails to see her evil actions as she takes advantage of him. Later, she plots to kill him for his property.

title: Orange Mittai
desc: Kailasam, a 55-year-old man who suffers from a heart condition, befriends Sathya and they embark on a journey to discover each other's deepest fears.

title: Thotti Jaya
desc: An orphan named Thotti Jaya is hired by a mobster after he is spotted thrashing a dishonest man. However, his troubles begin when he falls in love with his boss' daughter.
